clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within Gnomeregan, Kernobee is trapped among the ruins. The goblin engineer uncovered Dark Iron involvement in the super rig, then was captured, beaten unconscious, and left in the dormitory quarters among the troggs.

While doing business or scavenging in Gnomeregan, Kernobee discovered the Dark Iron dwarves had helped build and operate the great super rig burrowing beneath the city. Knowing how dangerous this knowledge was, he tried to flee to Ratchet and warn his associate, Tinkerwiz. The Dark Irons caught him before he could escape.

Kernobee's captors beat him unconscious instead of killing him. They threw him into a small room along the dormitory corridor, opposite the Clean Zone. Feral troggs and radiation surround him, and he needs help to wake, reach safety, and get clear of the ruins.
